thread:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick sync: we've made three small handbook edits — updated discretionary PTO examples, clarified carryover cap language, and added a note about documented exceptions. Requirement: all managers must acknowledge and complete the "Policy Essentials" micro-course by Thu 2026-04-15.
Nora (Benefits): Handbook link: https://internal.handbook/sections/time-off. I added a short FAQ about accrual for hourly employees.
Hassan (Legal): Reviewed the edits. All set for US and CA; flagged one sentence for AUS contractors in the doc comments. Clara, can you confirm local compliance?
Clara (People Partner): Will review AUS line and post suggested rewording by Tue. If a manager requests an exception, please tag me in the tracker.
Ravi (People Ops): Tracker: https://sheets.redwood/policy-acks. How-to: managers set "Ack" = Yes + date. The micro-course is at https://learn.redwood/policy-essentials (SSO). Completion auto-syncs to the sheet.
Ezra (Recruiting): We'll add "manager ack complete" to the offer checklist template and the manager onboarding flow. Noted.
AckBot: Reminder scheduled: Managers without ack will get a DM Mon 2026-04-13 09:00 UTC.
Nora (Benefits): Note for payroll: carryover caps take effect for the next accrual period; any previously approved exceptions stay in place. I added that clarification to the handbook.
Ravi (People Ops): For reporting, admins can run the simple export command: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://people-api/export?sheet=policy-acks" | jq -r '.rows[] | [.manager,.acked,.date] | @csv'
Hassan (Legal): One more: ensure managers know this change is not retroactive. I added a short sentence to the handbook section explicitly stating that.
Clara (People Partner): If a manager is out on leave during the window, note it in the tracker with the leave dates and tag me. We'll treat those as exemptions.
Ezra (Recruiting): Quick Q: interim managers who step in for <2 weeks 1 should they complete the course?
Ravi (People Ops): Yes, unless it's under 7 days; in that case add a comment and tag @Clara.
Nora (Benefits): I'll prepare a 1-page FAQ and upload to the tracker comments today.
Ravi (People Ops): I'll post a short slide deck for people leads by Wed morning and follow up with the final compliance numbers after the deadline.
AckBot: Automated follow-up will run weekly until all managers ack.
Hassan (Legal): I'll join the final compliance review if needed.
Clara (People Partner): Running a pre-audit export on Mon 2026-04-20 and will send CSV to Compliance + People Ops.
Ravi (People Ops): Thanks all. Please escalate any blockers in the tracker comments. Closing thread for now.
